2124697713262354743.en_summary: China is actively sabotaging its own AI companies to win a hardware war with America. As Palmer Luckey explained: "China doesn't want Nvidia to sell GPUs to Chinese companies." "Right now, 600,000 H200 processors are sitting stranded at the docks because China refuses to clear the import permits." Private Chinese tech labs want $NVDA for top-tier compute. But buying American silicon keeps Chinese developers hooked on US architecture and funnels capital straight into American R&D. Beijing saw the trap. As Luckey put it: "They want to build an internal domestic processor industry, not build one that is dependent on the United States." China is intentionally handicapping its own AI labs today to force an independent supply chain tomorrow.
2124697713262354743.zh_summary: 中國正在積極破壞自己的 AI 公司以贏得與美國的硬件戰爭。正如 Palmer Luckey 解釋的：「中國不想讓英偉達向中國公司出售 GPU。」「目前，60 萬個 H200 處理器因中國拒絕清關進口許可而滯留在碼頭。」私人中國科技實驗室想要 $NVDA 用於頂級計算。但購買美國硅片使中國開發者依賴美國架構，並將資本直接注入美國研發。北京看到了陷阱。正如 Luckey 所說：「他們想建立內部國內處理器產業，而不是建立依賴美國的。」中國正在故意妨礙自己的 AI 實驗室今天，以強制明天獨立的供應鏈。
